from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Captures the financial data for one company in the document relevant to the task."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported in the document")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Securities code of the company, if provided")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial data")
    operating_revenue: Optional[float] = Field(description="Operating Revenue for the period")
    cash_paid_for_capex: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash paid for construction of fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets")
    currency: Optional[str] = Field(description="Currency of the financial figures, e.g. CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level class aggregating all extracted company data from the document."""
    companies: List[CompanyFinancialData] = Field(description="List of company financial records extracted from the document")
